about_the_game:
The Movember Handlebar DLC unlocks the most handsome ‘Handlebar’ moustache to adorn the upper lip of soldiers of every faction. Featuring a thick base leading into a truly extravagant swirl, this mighty mouser is sure to demand the respect of anyone you may face on the frontline.

Proceeds will be donated to the global, not-for-profit Movember organization.

Movember continues to shake up men’s health research, and transform the way that health services reach and support men, taking on prostate cancer, testicular cancer, mental health and suicide prevention with unwavering determination. For more information about the Movember Foundation, men’s health and ways to help further, visit .

The Movember Handlebar DLC is available for purchase until January 5, 2026. Purchased content will remain accessible after.

content_descriptors.notes:
This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: Frequent Violence or Gore, General Mature Content.
Gore and blood can be disabled completely with an in-game setting.
